tagline: Interactive lessons and practice for my UNSW Master of IT courses. Every answer starts hidden: **think, try, then reveal.**
footer: Original lessons and drills only. No problem-set text or solutions. Lecture examples are cited by slide.

courses.title: Foundations of Computer Science
courses.blurb: Every Week 1–2 topic, in lecture order, from zero to exam level. **Quiz 2 (Thu 1 Oct):** L2B → L3 → L4 → D2. [Coverage map](https://github.com/chaitanyavankhande/unsw-brain-gym/blob/main/docs/COVERAGE_COMP9020.md): every slide section and problem-set question type → the unit that trains it.
